groups.name: Optical fibre & AI data-centre connectivity
groups.why: HFCL and Sterlite Tech sell optical fibre, cable and connectivity into the same data-centre build-out that Corning serves; Lumentum and Coherent are the optical-components end of it.

GLW.name: Corning
GLW.note: optical fibre and connectivity for AI data centres - the closest listed replica of the fibre business

LITE.name: Lumentum
LITE.note: optical transceivers and lasers for AI data centres

groups.name: Memory & chips
groups.why: GNG Electronics refurbishes and sells computing hardware whose cost and demand follow the memory cycle that Samsung, SK hynix and Micron report on.

000660.KS.name: SK hynix
000660.KS.note: memory (DRAM, HBM) - closes before India's market, so the read-across is same-day

MU.name: Micron
MU.note: US memory maker - reports quarterly guidance the whole memory chain trades on

groups.name: AI cloud & GPU servers
groups.why: Netweb builds GPU servers (as Super Micro does) and E2E Networks rents GPU capacity (as Nebius and CoreWeave do); NVIDIA supplies all of them and its results set the tone.

NVDA.name: NVIDIA
NVDA.note: GPUs for every name in this group; its quarter sets the whole chain's tone

NBIS.name: Nebius
NBIS.note: GPU cloud - the listed replica of E2E Networks

SMCI.name: Super Micro Computer
SMCI.note: AI server maker - the listed replica of Netweb
